requirements: Bind every observation to its legal/business/asset subject, unit, period and source.
Do not replace an observed source-period conflict by guessing a corrected number.
Use Cameco's actual Q2 Fuel Services table and preserve the web/link error.
Keep blended realized unit price distinct from a pure commodity-market quote.
Keep contract revenue mix distinct from volume, margin and future price sensitivity.
Do not double count equity-method investee sales in consolidated sales.
Separate current operating supply from future enrichment expansion.
Treat definitive agreements as conditional when construction/funding conditions remain.
Do not infer fully funded backlog from nested-set subtraction.
Separate award ceiling, funded portion and exercised options.
Separate contract prepayment provisions from actual receipts and refundable obligations.
Financing pricing, closing and actual unrestricted cash are different receipts.
Keep common shares, pre-funded warrants and common warrants distinct.
Do not count future warrant cash as present funds; preserve cashless election rights.
Post-quarter acquisition cannot explain that quarter's acquired revenue.
Government/commercial/medical businesses do not inherit one nuclear multiple.
Standard design approval is not a site operating license.
Groves criticality cannot prove Aurora grid operation.
Do not propagate HALEU dependence to conventional-fuel SMRs.
Engineering/licensing income is not recurring plant electricity revenue.
Signed negotiations, FEED, purchase agreement and firm PPA have distinct evidence.
Credit recognition, eligibility, receivable, transfer and receipt are different.
Do not add credit income twice when receivables become cash.
Historical credit-sale discounts are not current monetization quotes.
Safe-harbor exclusions are not measured end-customer sell-through.
Refund recognition and cash dates must be separately shown.
RFI/RFP or product demonstrations are not booked sales.
Service backlog is not one-year revenue, profit or guaranteed cash.
Warranty consumption is not automatically a profit release or exact cash payment.
LTM EPS in quarterly tables must retain its horizon.
Farm-down proceeds cannot coexist with 100% retained future project cash.
Positive FCF including disposals is not automatically self-funding construction.
Defined EBITDA adjustments and statutory EBITDA remain separate.
Developer, equipment supplier and asset owner need different unit economics.
Storage integrator revenue does not imply ownership of asset trading proceeds.
Battery MW, usable MWh, duration and throughput have different denominators.
Model charging losses and avoid simultaneous incompatible revenue services.
Do not add augmentation twice when a published cost model includes it in O&M.
Resource capacity growth is not same-asset margin growth.
Geothermal equipment/pilot evidence is not proof of commercial reservoir cash.
Use Ormat's dated comparator and retain the prose discrepancy.
Fuel-flexible capability is not proof of actual hydrogen demand.
Gross break-even, EBITDA, EBITDAS, net profit and free cash differ.
Recurring revenue with negative unit margin is not automatically an economic moat.
No runway from total cash divided by a single quarter's selected cash-usage label.
No stock re-rating or mispricing verdict without matched expectations and valuation evidence.
Issuer consensus location is not proof an as-of panel has been acquired.
All research stays context-only with existing identity/evidence/publication owners.
Negative income bases cannot produce a misleading percentage earnings-growth label.
Scope a technology/regulatory milestone to the exact product, asset and jurisdiction.
